Speaker: Jensen Huang
Host (never attribute their words to the speaker): Chamath Palihapitiya, Jason Calacanis, David Sacks, David Friedberg
Source: "Jensen Huang: The Doomer Hoax, Superintelligence i

claims.claim: Jensen Huang's stance is that AI safety is paramount.
claims.resolutionCriteria: Future public statements or actions by Jensen Huang show whether he continues to describe AI safety as paramount.

claims.quote:
obviously the the
coxin uh whistleblower is very serious
matter. When whenever you have a
whistleblower, you got to take it very
seriously.
claims.claim: Jensen Huang's stance is that the Coxin whistleblower matter is very serious and AI whistleblowers should be taken very seriously.
claims.resolutionCriteria: Future public statements by Jensen Huang show whether he continues to say AI whistleblower matters should be taken very seriously.

claims.quote:
Uh I think the
the the whistleblowing is is fine. I

uh about the future uh is less aligned

claims.claim: Jensen Huang's stance is that the AI-future scientific prediction discussed in the essay was not grounded in science.
claims.resolutionCriteria: Future public statements by Jensen Huang show whether he continues to characterize that AI-future prediction as not grounded in science.

claims.quote:
That has proven to be exactly the
opposite. We need more radiologists than
ever in the world.
claims.claim: Jensen Huang says the world needs more radiologists than ever, contrary to predictions that AI would eliminate radiologists.
claims.resolutionCriteria: Public labor-market data, radiology workforce statistics, or credible industry reports show whether radiologist demand or employment is at record levels.

claims.quote:
Uh
within 6 to 12 months, uh 90%
of code would already be generated uh by
AI. That has turned out to be wrong.
claims.claim: Jensen Huang says it is false that 90% of code was generated by AI within 6 to 12 months of the prior prediction.
claims.resolutionCriteria: Credible software-development surveys, repository analyses, or company reports show whether AI generated 90% of code in the relevant period.

claims.quote:
Uh
within 6 to9 months, that was predicted
last year, 50% of entry jobs will be
wiped out. That has proven to be wrong.
claims.claim: Jensen Huang says it is false that 50% of entry-level jobs were wiped out within 6 to 9 months of a 2025 prediction.
claims.resolutionCriteria: Public labor statistics or credible employment research show whether entry-level jobs declined by 50% in the relevant period.

claims.quote:
Like
for example, we don't welcome uh
political discourse in our inside our
company. Take it home. You guys talk
about politics outside the company.
claims.claim: Nvidia does not welcome political discourse inside the company.
claims.resolutionCriteria: Nvidia employee policies, internal guidance reported by credible sources, or consistent public statements by Nvidia leadership confirm whether political discourse is unwelcome inside the company.

claims.quote:
You know, regulation should solve actual
problems.
claims.claim: Jensen Huang's stance is that AI regulation should solve actual problems.
claims.resolutionCriteria: Future public statements or policy advocacy by Jensen Huang show whether he continues to support AI regulation only when it addresses actual problems.
